name: DIY Personalized Reindeer Mug
age: Preschool (3 - 5 years), Early Elementary ( K - 2nd grade), Tweens (3rd - 5th grade)
raw: DIY Personalized Reindeer Mug | Monday, December 21, 2026 12:30pm |  Come make your own personalized reindeer mug, and enjoy some hot chocolate. Pre-printed templates with have names of those who registered, add your own touches, then drink some hot chocolate while we heat and press your design on a mug. Parental support is need for children under 6 **Mugs take 20-30 minutes to press and cool, pick up next day also available**
